method: All 20 first corrected Vulkan04 scenes were visually compared with frozen02 on 10 full-scene sheets.

Every segment of all 88 planned seam/junction/final-edge samples was viewed on 36 sheets; entire strip interval coverage is checked in this record. Frozen is left and Vulkan is right. Vertical strips are rotated 90 degrees, long strips remain at source scale, and small junctions use nearest-neighbour enlargement.
Both former 41-pixel regions were inspected in four detail/context sheets, including frozen02, software02, failed Vulkan01/03, corrected Vulkan04 and fresh Vulkan05.
Transparent pixels are composited over neutral gray only in visual sheets. Raw indexed, palette, alpha and RGBA equality is evaluated without this presentation transform.

The manual-mechanical audit binds four lanes and all viewed sheet source files. The independent six-lane audit binds all 120 PNG decodes and four raw buffers across frozen01/02, software01/02 and Vulkan04/05, plus 22,341 unique input/artifact pins.
observations: Across all rotations, grass/sand slopes, stepped terrain, wood/rock cliffs, water basins, balloons and tall corner pillars match the frozen full-scene composition. Zoom 2/3 reduction and map boundaries are coherent.

All seam and junction samples preserve terrain triangles, cliff texture alignment, water lookup patterns and balloon edges. Final row/column strips preserve their mostly background pixels and the visible park/pillar fragments exactly.
Ordinary and transparent background boundaries match their respective frozen outputs. No new visible discrepancy was found.
limits: Qualification is limited to the pinned giant-input fixture, 20 camera/background cases and these six capture lanes.
This record establishes pixel parity for corrected tiled CLI screenshots, not universal renderer parity, retained main-window terrain admission, exclusive Vulkan readiness, performance or Gate P.
No builds, game processes or GPU tests were run during this manual review.
Historical build receipts pin captured source inputs and immutable binary artifacts; they are not a claim of hermetic executable reproduction.
causeAndCorrection: Vertical tile subdivision changed CPU paint generation/admission and reproduced the same 41 water pixels in software. The selected tiled screenshot path now generates/arranges each column over the full viewport height while restoring the actual tile raster target before drawing; default software targetClip remains unchanged. Corrected software full/tiled controls and both Vulkan full-image runs are exact.
